pairs: Ego autem ab anno primo Darii Medi stabam ut confortaretur et roboraretur.
“And so, from the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood firm, so that he might be reinforced and strengthened.
And now I will announce to you the truth. Behold,
Ecce adhuc tres reges stabunt in Perside,
up to a certain point, three kings will stand in Persia,
et quartus ditabitur opibus nimiis super omnes:
and the fourth will be exceedingly enriched in power above them all.
And when he has grown strong by his resources,
he will stir up all against the kingdom of Greece.
But there will rise up a strong king,
and he will rule with great power,
and he will do what he pleases.
Et cum steterit, conteretur regnum ejus,
And when he has been firmly established,
et dividetur in quatuor ventos cæli: sed non in posteros ejus,
his kingdom will be shattered and will be divided towards the four winds of the heaven,
neque secundum potentiam illius, qua dominatus est:
but not to his posterity, nor according to his power with which he ruled.
lacerabitur enim regnum ejus etiam in externos, exceptis his.
For his kingdom will be torn to pieces, even for the outsiders who have been expelled from these.
And the king of the South will be reinforced,
et de principibus ejus prævalebit super eum,
yet one of his leaders will prevail over him,
and he will rule with riches,
And after the end of years, they will form a federation,
filiaque regis austri veniet ad regem aquilonis facere amicitiam,
and the daughter of the king of the South will come to the king of the North to make friendship,
et non obtinebit fortitudinem brachii, nec stabit semen ejus:
but she will not obtain the strength of arms, neither will her offspring stand firm,
and she will be handed over,
et qui adduxerunt eam adolescentes ejus,
along with those who brought her, her young men,
et qui confortabant eam in temporibus.
and those who comforted her in these times.
Et stabit de germine radicum ejus plantatio:
And a transplant from the germination of her roots will stand up,
and he will come with an army,
and will enter into the province of the king of the North,
et sculptilia, vasa quoque pretiosa argenti et auri,
he will carry away captive into Egypt their gods, and their graven images,
captiva ducet in Ægyptum: ipse prævalebit adversus regem aquilonis.
and likewise their precious vessels of gold and silver. He will prevail against the king of the North.
Et intrabit in regnum rex austri,
And the king of the South will enter into the kingdom,
and will return to his own land.
But his sons will be challenged,
and they will assemble a multitude of very many forces.
And he will be turned back,
and he will join the battle in his redness.
And the king of the South, having being challenged,
will go forth and will fight against the king of the North,
and he will prepare an exceedingly great multitude,
et dabitur multitudo in manu ejus.
and a multitude will be given into his hand.
And he will seize a multitude,
and his heart will be exalted,
and he will cast down many thousands,
Convertetur enim rex aquilonis, et præparabit multitudinem multo majorem quam prius:
For the king of the North will change strategy and will prepare a multitude much greater than before,
et in fine temporum annorumque veniet properans cum exercitu magno, et opibus nimiis.
and at the end of times and years, he will rush forward with a great army and exceedingly great resources.
Et in temporibus illis multi consurgent adversus regem austri:
And in those times, many will rise up against the king of the South.
filii quoque prævaricatorum populi tui extollentur ut impleant visionem,
And likewise the sons of the deceivers among your people will extol themselves, so as to fulfill the vision,
And the king of the North will arrive
and he will seize the most fortified cities.
And the arms of the South will not withstand him,
et consurgent electi ejus ad resistendum,
and his elect will rise up to resist,
Et faciet veniens super eum juxta placitum suum,
And when he arrives, he will do just as he pleases,
et non erit qui stet contra faciem ejus:
and there will be none who stand against his face.
And he will stand in the illustrious land,
and it will be consumed by his hand.
Et ponet faciem suam ut veniat ad tenendum universum regnum ejus,
And he will set his face to strive to hold his entire kingdom,
and he will make fair conditions with him.
And he will give him a daughter among women,
neither will she be for him.
Et convertet faciem suam ad insulas,
And he will turn his face towards the islands,
et cessare faciet principem opprobrii sui,
And he will cause the leader of his reproach to cease,
et opprobrium ejus convertetur in eum.
and his reproach will be turned around for him.
Et convertet faciem suam ad imperium terræ suæ,
And he will turn his face to the empire of his own land,
Et stabit in loco ejus vilissimus,
And there will stand up in his place one who is most worthless and unworthy of kingly honor.
Et stabit in loco ejus despectus,
And there will stand up in his place the despicable one,
et non tribuetur ei honor regius:
and he will not be assigned the honor of a king.
And he will arrive in secret,
and he will obtain the kingdom by deceitfulness.
Et brachia pugnantis expugnabuntur a facie ejus,
And the arms of the fighting will be assaulted before his face and will be shattered,
and he will go up and will overcome with a small people.
And he will enter into rich
et faciet quæ non fecerunt patres ejus,
and he will do what his fathers never did,
and will form a plan against the most steadfast,
et cor ejus adversum regem austri in exercitu magno:
and his heart will be enraged against the king of the South with a great army.
et rex austri provocabitur ad bellum multis auxiliis,
And the king of the South will be provoked into going to war by having many allies
and yet these will not stand,
for they will form plans against him.
And those who eat bread with him will crush him,
and his army will be suppressed,
Duorum quoque regum cor erit ut malefaciant,
And the heart of two kings will be similar, to do harm,
et ad mensam unam mendacium loquentur:
and they will speak lies at one table,
quia adhuc finis in aliud tempus.
because as yet the end is for another time.
Et revertetur in terram suam cum opibus multis:
And he will return to his land with many resources.
et cor ejus adversum testamentum sanctum,
And his heart will be against the holy testament,
and he will return to his own land.
At the appointed time, he will return,
and he will approach the South,
et non erit priori simile novissimum.
but the latter time will not be like the former.
Et venient super eum trieres, et Romani:
And the Greek warships and the Romans will come upon him,
and will have scorn against the testament of the sanctuary,
reverteturque, et cogitabit adversum eos qui dereliquerunt testamentum sanctuarii.
And he will return and will consult their adversaries, who have forsaken the covenant of the sanctuary.
And arms will take his side,
and they will pollute the sanctuary of the strength,
and they will take away the continual sacrifice
and will replace it with the abomination of desolation.
Et impii in testamentum simulabunt fraudulenter:
And the impious within the testament will imitate deceitfully,
Et docti in populo docebunt plurimos:
And the teachers among the people will teach many,
but they will be ruined by the sword,
and by assaults for many days.
they will be supported with a little help,
but many will apply to them deceitfully.
Et de eruditis ruent, ut conflentur,
And some of the learned will be ruined,
et eligantur, et dealbentur usque ad tempus præfinitum:
that they may be kindled and chosen and purified, up to the predetermined time,
because there will be still another time.
Et faciet juxta voluntatem suam rex,
And the king will act according to his will,
and he will be lifted up and will be extolled against every god.
And he will speak great things against the God of gods,
et adversus Deum deorum loquetur magnifica,
the limit is reached with certainty.
Et Deum patrum suorum non reputabit:
And he will give no thought to the God of his fathers,
and he will be in the desire of women,
and he will not attend to any gods,
because he will rise up against all things.
Deum autem Maozim in loco suo venerabitur:
But he will do homage to the god Maozim in his place,
a god whom his fathers did not know,
Et faciet ut muniat Maozim cum deo alieno,
And he will act to reinforce Maozim with an alien god,
of whom he has become aware,
and he will increase their glory,
et dabit eis potestatem in multis,
and will give them power over many,
and he will distribute land for free.
Et in tempore præfinito præliabitur adversus eum rex austri,
And, at the predetermined time, the king of the South will fight against him,
et quasi tempestas veniet contra illum rex aquilonis in curribus,
and the king of the North will come against him like a tempest, with chariots,
and he will enter into the lands,
and will crush and pass through.
And he will enter into the glorious land,
hæ autem solæ salvabuntur de manu ejus,
But only these will be saved from his hand:
and the first part of the sons of Ammon.
Et mittet manum suam in terras:
And he will cast his hand upon the lands,
and the land of Egypt will not escape.
And he will rule over the treasure chests of gold,
and all the precious things of Egypt,
and likewise he will pass through Libya
Et fama turbabit eum ab oriente et ab aquilone:
And rumors from the East and from the North will trouble him.
et veniet in multitudine magna ut conterat et interficiat plurimos.
And he will arrive with a great multitude to destroy and to execute many.
Et figet tabernaculum suum Apadno inter maria,
And he will fasten his tabernacle, Apadno, between the seas,
upon an illustrious and holy mountain,
et veniet usque ad summitatem ejus,
and he will come even to its summit,
and no one will help him.”
